purpose: Prospectively freeze the terminal 200-species image-first atlas inference cascade before any terminal-scaleout candidate pixels are opened.

terminal_scaleout_sampling.cohort_assignment_rule: Use the already frozen deterministic randomized panel assignment from the terminal scaleout selection; do not redraw after colour measurement.
terminal_scaleout_sampling.within_species_sampling: Use the already frozen terminal selection and global-id/geometry admission rules; do not replace observations after colour measurement except for prospectively coded non-colour technical failure rules.
terminal_scaleout_sampling.sampling_repetition_interpretation: C01-C08 are eight independently randomized, disjoint replication cohorts that partition the frozen 200-species universe.

colour_field_freeze.representation: continuous CIELAB colour vectors from the frozen ROI pipeline
colour_field_freeze.species_standardization: freeze before spatial inference and reuse the identical standardized colour vectors for all downstream branches

not_evaluable_rule: not_evaluable is not evidence of absence. It never advances a confirmatory branch.

species_conditioned_spatial_organization.graph: Within each species, spherical k-nearest-neighbour graph constructed from coordinates only; colour never selects neighbours or edges.
species_conditioned_spatial_organization.colour_score: Continuous multivariate CIELAB edge discontinuity using the frozen standardized colour vectors.
species_conditioned_spatial_organization.null: Complete colour-vector permutation strictly within species with graph and sampling fixed.
species_conditioned_spatial_organization.species_weighting: Compute species statistics first, then use equal-species aggregation.
species_conditioned_spatial_organization.primary_atlas_test: One pooled equal-species statistic over all evaluable species, calibrated by synchronized within-species permutations.
species_conditioned_spatial_organization.replication_check: Compute the same equal-species statistic independently for every frozen C01-C08 cohort; report all eight observed-minus-null-center directions.
species_conditioned_spatial_organization.support_rule: supported iff the primary pooled permutation p-value is <=0.05 and at least 6 of 8 frozen cohorts have observed statistic greater than their null median; unsupported iff all eight cohorts are evaluable and this rule is not met; otherwise not_evaluable.
species_conditioned_spatial_organization.multiple_testing: Species-level results are descriptive and retain multiplicity-adjusted q-values; the confirmatory branch is the single pooled atlas test plus the frozen cohort replication check.

shared_transition.surface: For each species, map edge-level continuous colour discontinuity to the pre-frozen equal-area spatial geometry, then convert detectable-cell transition scores to within-species ranks.
shared_transition.cell_statistic: For each cell with sufficient detectable species, count species whose transition rank is >=0.9 and standardize the excess above the 0.1 null exceedance expectation conditional on detectable species count.
shared_transition.global_statistic: Maximum standardized co-exceedance across prospectively valid cells; the spatial scan is calibrated by the same complete within-species vector permutations, so scanning is inside the null.
shared_transition.species_weighting: Each species contributes at most one exceedance indicator per cell; no species is weighted by observation or edge count.
shared_transition.replication_check: Repeat the shared-transition scan independently in every frozen C01-C08 cohort and report all eight directions; no cohort may be selected post hoc.
shared_transition.support_rule: supported iff the pooled shared-transition permutation p-value is <=0.05 and at least 6 of 8 frozen cohorts have positive observed-minus-null-center direction; unsupported iff the pooled and all eight cohort tests are evaluable and this rule is not met; otherwise not_evaluable.
shared_transition.qualification_failure_rule: If the exact terminal-scaleout geometry fails preimage qualification, shared_transition is not_evaluable; do not tune on candidate colours and do not advance to environment on that basis.

environmental_concordance.prerequisite: Run confirmatorily only after the preceding spatial branch returns unsupported, never after not_evaluable.
environmental_concordance.colour_input: Reuse the identical frozen colour field and hashes from the spatial branch.

pollinator_biogeographic_concordance.priority: Independent Bombus/major-pollinator biogeographic boundaries; pollinator geography must not be derived from the flower-colour field.

publication_rule: The manuscript must preserve supported, unsupported, and not_evaluable separately and must report the frozen branch actually reached rather than choosing the most favourable overlay after seeing results.
